title: Concept: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy explicitly allows every origin
description: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy was explicitly set to cross-origin, the value that permits every site to load the resource in a cross-origin context. The protection exists to stop other origins from embedding a response; this value removes it, and a leak or a side-channel that relies on embedding becomes reachable again.
applicability: Responses that opt into cross-origin embedding of their body.
risk: Cross-origin embedding of responses that should stay origin-bound; LOW severity because the header is defense-in-depth.
